title: Certified Response Pack (CRP) pilot — on-demand security answer bundles with SLA pricing
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise prospects frequently stall at RFP/security questionnaires because (a) generating verified, consistent answers takes legal/engineering time and (b) customers ask for attestations/evidence with expiry windows. Objective: Pilot an on-demand 'Certified Response Pack' (CRP) that packages curated SIG/CAIQ answers + minimal evidence snippets + a digital fingerprint and TTL. CRP is sold as a priced bundle (one-off or credit-based) and optionally backed by a short-term SLA (response quality and evidence availability). We want to test buyer willingness to pay for low-friction, contract-ready answer bundles and reduce waist-of-time for Sales/SEs.
success_metrics: 1) % reduction in time-to-sign for pilot cohort (target: -25%). 2) Conversion uplift for sales-qualified leads engaging CRP (target +8%). 3) Number of unique customers purchasing CRP in pilot (target >= 12). 4) Avg manual legal hours saved per deal (target >= 3 hrs). 5) No major security incidents or incorrect statements in CRPs.
pricing_model_variants: Variant A: One-off CRP per contract priced by footprint (tiered low/medium/high). Variant B: CRP credits sold in bundles (10/50/200) with discounted per-CRP price. Variant C: Subscription addon that includes N CRPs per year plus expedited updates. SLA add-on: 48h guaranteed curated update window + signed evidence export. We will A/B test A vs B for buyer acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: - Confluence CRP schema and canonical answer set approved by Security and Legal. - Backend endpoint for CRP request/pay flow implemented and integrated with billing test account. - CRP package includes CAIQ mapping, short evidence snippets, and a signed digital fingerprint. - Pilot purchase flow validated in staging and 3 sales pilots scheduled. - Pricing telemetry is emitted to analytics (price variant, conversion, churn).
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (now->2 wks): Finalize catalog and legal checklist; get Security sign-off. Phase 1 (2-6 wks): Build checkout + delivery flow; wire billing and audit log; run 12 closed pilot customers via AE team. Phase 2 (6-10 wks): Evaluate results; iterate pricing; add console UX for CRP requests. Phase 3 (post-pilot): Decide GA packaging (self-serve vs sales-assisted).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: CRPs misrepresent controls and create compliance risk. Mitigation: All answers must pass Security/Legal review; include explicit TTL and scope in the pack; make packs non-transferable and revoke-able. Risk: Low demand. Mitigation: Run targeted AE pilots and offer first-CRP discount. Risk: Operational overhead for frequent updates. Mitigation: Add evidence TTL and automated re-issuance hooks; limit update frequency in pilot.
